fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today and tonight...Numerous showers and thunderstorms will develop this afternoon and move east through the evening, some with locally heavy rainfall. Temperatures will be near or just above normal, but humidity readings will be elevated due to high atmospheric moisture content. Winds outside of showers and storms will be relatively light and follow normal diurnal wind patterns. LON
